input: Arrange a will reading meeting with my siblings

gold.taskTitle: Arrange a will reading meeting with siblings
gold.taskDescription: Organise and coordinate a formal or informal will reading meeting that brings together the user's siblings in the context of a deceased person's estate.

questions.title: Whose will is being read at this meeting?
questions.description: Identify the deceased or the person whose will is being discussed, to understand the legal and emotional context.

questions.title: How many siblings need to attend this meeting?
questions.description: Clarify the number of attendees to help with scheduling, venue sizing, and communication logistics.

questions.title: Will a solicitor or lawyer be present at the reading?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a formal legal proceeding requiring a solicitor or an informal family gathering to review the document.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred date or deadline for this?
questions.description: Understand any time constraints, urgency, or legally imposed deadlines that affect when the meeting must happen.

questions.title: Where should the meeting take place physically or virtually?
questions.description: Establish the preferred venue, such as a solicitor's office, family home, or a video call, especially if siblings are geographically spread out.

questions.title: Are all siblings currently on speaking terms with each other?
questions.description: Identify any interpersonal tensions or estrangements that may affect how invitations should be handled or who should coordinate communication.

questions.title: Who is responsible for formally notifying each sibling?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user will contact everyone directly, or if a solicitor, executor, or another party will handle official notifications.
